description: Publish an extension to Chrome Web Store. Supports immediate publish, staged publish, initial deploy percentage, and skip-review.

blockOnWarnings.description: Reject publishing when validation returns warnings (default: false)

deployPercentage.description: Initial deploy percentage for staged rollout (0-100). Only used with STAGED_PUBLISH or DEFAULT_PUBLISH.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publishType.description: DEFAULT_PUBLISH: publishes immediately after approval. STAGED_PUBLISH: stages for manual publishing after approval. Defaults to DEFAULT_PUBLISH.

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

skipReview.description: Attempt to skip review if the extension qualifies. Defaults to false.

name: publish
